title: Graphic Designer
description:

Coordinates with internal teams, including marketing, in the design concept phase through completion of a project.Obtains approval of concepts by preparing rough layouts for review.
Prepares final layout by marking and pasting up finished copy and art.
Desktop publishing tools and graphic design software.
